headline: TruAlt Bioenergy announces resignation of company secretary Monu Kumar
hook: Compliance officer steps down at TruAlt
summary: TruAlt Bioenergy Limited has informed the stock exchange that Mr. Monu Kumar is resigning from his role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The resignation will take effect from October 16, 2026. Such management departures are routine corporate developments for listed entities. Indian retail investors should note this administrative change as part of the company's governance disclosures.
whats_next: Appointment of a new company secretary
why_it_matters: Routine management filing with no direct impact on stock price.

headline: TruAlt Bioenergy announces notice of postal ballot for shareholder voting
hook: Postal ballot notice issued to shareholders
summary: TruAlt Bioenergy Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding the dispatch of a postal ballot notice to its shareholders. The filing is a procedural corporate requirement to seek shareholder approval on upcoming business resolutions. Such postal ballots typically deal with special resolutions requiring remote e-voting. Indian retail shareholders holding the stock should review the resolutions and participate in the e-voting process.
whats_next: Postal ballot e-voting dates and results
why_it_matters: Shareholders can vote on corporate resolutions via e-voting.
